title: The Room Story: room, baselines, service history, audit events (data steward), ledger integrity, read model

assertions.name: the room reads back COMMISSIONING (recommissioning) with revision 3 approved and every device

the story keeps the position history (its design: absent from revision 1 — the room was created empty — generic in revision 2, the new model in revision 3) apart from each unit’s own history (one installation each, with both ends)
the baseline lineage holds v1 (CURRENT) and no other version
the service history reads (no work order was needed: no test failed) with the room’s issue events
the designer cannot read the audit trail (403)
the Evidence Ledger chain verifies end to end (data steward)
the room’s 366 audit events are sealed into the chain, in order (sequence, id and time agree)

the Room Story reads in order: created → design approved → window → installed → commissioning → results → verification → baseline v1 published by the acceptance → recommissioned → camera replaced → revision approved
the refusals of the scenario are in the trail too (DENIED, with the actor’s role)
the acceptance is audited as delegated, naming the delegation and its grantor
the domain events of the change were delivered by the outbox: room.device_swapped, commission.asset_replaced, room.design_approved
the operational read model is rebuilt from the events: COMMISSIONING, live health NOT_MONITORED

body.method: SHA-256 chain per tenant: hash = sha256(previous hash ‖ canonical event); recomputed in the API process, independently of the sealing function
limits: Events committed since the last seal are not yet in the chain (this check seals first; events committed during the check may remain unsealed).
The chain proves nothing about changes made before migration 0024 sealed the existing events.
Someone able to rewrite an event and every later hash inside the database is detected only by comparing this head with one recorded outside the database.

why: revision 3 is not newer than the approved revision 3

the design changed while the room is recommissioned (PA-0061 generic → SYN-PTZ-12X (synthetic PTZ camera)) and the approved revision 2 no longer describes it: revision 3 needs approval (room.design.approve, not its author) — the re-acceptance binds the approved revision
2 open issue(s): every deficiency is closed with its retest before acceptance

12 test(s) were last recorded before the substitution and must be re-run on the changed design and verified independently: identity_asset, display_controls, video_signal, camera_preset, video_camera_exposure, video_content_share, video_display_calibration, video_edid_handshake, video_switching, camera_fov, video_av_sync, video_camera_tracking — acceptance counts 63 of 75 applicable tests as passed and independently verified; the 12 earlier result(s) no longer count
separation of duties: the acceptance (its recorded and verified results) cannot be approved by its own author (qa_reviewer)
verification must be independent of the person who recorded the result
